Page prints ٤٥٠,٢٩٣,٠٦٤. Together with r38 accounts for exactly the 30,001,000 shortfall in column 2 current liabilities.
Page prints ٤٣,٩٤٦,٠٨٧; annotation read ٤٣ as ١٣. Supplies the 30,000,000 of the column 2 shortfall.

Column 1 total assets exceeds non-current + current by exactly 81 after the 2026-09-07 corrections.
